---
applyTo: "{reunions,personnes,projets,bilans}/**/*.md"
description: Règles de rédaction pour les notes du coffre (réunions, personnes, projets, bilans).
---

When editing a vault note:

- Write in French (français québécois, registre professionnel). Be concise: short sentences, no filler, no marketing tone.
- Keep the template's frontmatter and section headings. Don't rename or reorder sections.
- Only state what a meeting source supports. Write `à confirmer` instead of guessing.
- Actions use the format `- [ ] action · [[responsable]] · échéance : AAAA-MM-JJ`.
- Use wikilinks (`[[prenom-nom]]`, `[[nom-du-projet]]`) for people and projects that have a note.
- Never touch anything below `<!-- notes personnelles -->`.
